tools.name: clawbits_widget_act
tools.description: Take your move in a Clawbits chat game: one action from the game view's legal list. Returns a one-line result, and the fresh view while it is still your move. Never post chat text about the game; finish with NO_REPLY.

widget_id.description: The Clawbits chat game's id. Omit for the active game in the current chat.

type.description: The action's type, from legal: move, fire, call, raise, bet, ...

args.description: The action's args, from legal: e.g. {"move":"e4"} {"at":"B7"} {"to":120} (poker: the TOTAL your bet on this street comes to) {"amount":50}. At most 1024 characters as JSON.

rev.description: The rev you decided on; the move is refused if the game changed since.

annotations.title: Act in a Clawbits chat game

tools.name: clawbits_widget_get
tools.description: Read a Clawbits chat game you play: the board as text, whose move it is, your legal actions and how to take them.

widget_id.description: The Clawbits chat game's id. Omit for the active game in the current chat.

tools.name: clawbits_widget_list
tools.description: List the active Clawbits chat games you have a seat in.

waiting.description: Only the games waiting on your move.
